/**
 * |ObjectNamePluralC| JSON API controller — generated by the Wheels CLI.
 *
 * Returns JSON (via `provides("json")`) and uses `renderWith(data=...)` for a
 * consistent envelope. Top-level keys are quoted so their case is the same on
 * every engine, lists are arrays of records, a missing or unreadable request
 * body is a 400, and a key that can't exist is a 404. Extends wheels.Controller directly, so it does not
 * inherit the app base controller's CSRF/session filters.
 */
component extends="wheels.Controller" {

    function config() {
        provides("json");
        filters(through="setJsonResponse");
    }

    /**
     * GET /|ObjectNamePlural|
     * Returns a list of all |ObjectNamePlural|
     */
    function index() {
        local.|ObjectNamePlural| = model("|ObjectNameSingular|").findAll(returnAs="objects");
        renderWith(data={ "|ObjectNamePlural|"=local.|ObjectNamePlural| });
    }

    /**
     * GET /|ObjectNamePlural|/:key
     * Returns a specific |ObjectNameSingular| by ID
     */
    function show() {
        local.|ObjectNameSingular| = findRecord();

        if (IsObject(local.|ObjectNameSingular|)) {
            renderWith(data={ "|ObjectNameSingular|"=local.|ObjectNameSingular| });
        } else {
            renderWith(data={ "error"="Record not found" }, status=404);
        }
    }

    /**
     * POST /|ObjectNamePlural|
     * Creates a new |ObjectNameSingular|
     */
    function create() {
        if (!hasRecordParams()) {
            renderWith(data={ "error"=missingBodyMessage() }, status=400);
            return;
        }
        local.|ObjectNameSingular| = model("|ObjectNameSingular|").new(params.|ObjectNameSingular|);

        if (local.|ObjectNameSingular|.save()) {
            renderWith(data={ "|ObjectNameSingular|"=local.|ObjectNameSingular| }, status=201);
        } else {
            renderWith(data={ "error"="Validation failed", "errors"=local.|ObjectNameSingular|.allErrors() }, status=422);
        }
    }

    /**
     * PUT /|ObjectNamePlural|/:key
     * Updates an existing |ObjectNameSingular|
     */
    function update() {
        local.|ObjectNameSingular| = findRecord();

        if (!IsObject(local.|ObjectNameSingular|)) {
            renderWith(data={ "error"="Record not found" }, status=404);
            return;
        }
        if (!hasRecordParams()) {
            renderWith(data={ "error"=missingBodyMessage() }, status=400);
            return;
        }
        local.|ObjectNameSingular|.update(params.|ObjectNameSingular|);

        if (local.|ObjectNameSingular|.hasErrors()) {
            renderWith(data={ "error"="Validation failed", "errors"=local.|ObjectNameSingular|.allErrors() }, status=422);
        } else {
            renderWith(data={ "|ObjectNameSingular|"=local.|ObjectNameSingular| });
        }
    }

    /**
     * DELETE /|ObjectNamePlural|/:key
     * Deletes a |ObjectNameSingular|
     */
    function delete() {
        local.|ObjectNameSingular| = findRecord();

        if (IsObject(local.|ObjectNameSingular|)) {
            local.|ObjectNameSingular|.delete();
            renderWith(data={}, status=204);
        } else {
            renderWith(data={ "error"="Record not found" }, status=404);
        }
    }

    /**
     * The record for params.key, or false. A key that can't be a key for this
     * model (`abc` for an integer primary key) makes findByKey() throw
     * Wheels.InvalidValue; no record can have it, so the caller's 404 applies.
     * Any other error is rethrown.
     */
    private any function findRecord() {
        try {
            local.|ObjectNameSingular| = model("|ObjectNameSingular|").findByKey(params.key);
        } catch (any e) {
            if (e.type != "Wheels.InvalidValue") {
                rethrow;
            }
            return false;
        }
        return local.|ObjectNameSingular|;
    }

    /**
     * True when the request carried the record's fields as a JSON object under
     * the "|ObjectNameSingular|" key. A missing wrapper or a body that isn't valid
     * JSON leaves it absent.
     */
    private boolean function hasRecordParams() {
        return StructKeyExists(params, "|ObjectNameSingular|") && IsStruct(params.|ObjectNameSingular|);
    }

    private string function missingBodyMessage() {
        return 'The request body must be a JSON object with the record''s fields under a "|ObjectNameSingular|" key, e.g. {"|ObjectNameSingular|": {...}}.';
    }

    /**
     * Set Response to JSON
     */
    private function setJsonResponse() {
        params.format = "json";
    }

}
